issues.description: The reference answer contains a claim that section s0001 does not state: 'made by a lens with four bright panels that turned once every forty seconds'. In s0001 the lens is described only in d02-p005 (rings of cut glass bending a single oil flame into one narrow beam); the flash pattern is in d02-p006. The four panels and the forty-second rotation appear only in d02-p008, which belongs to section s0002. Suggested fix: Remove the clause 'made by a lens with four bright panels that turned once every forty seconds' from the answer, leaving: 'Every light had its own pattern of flashes, and sailors counted them. Gannet Rock gave one white flash every ten seconds; no other light on the coast did the same.' Keep the citation to d02-p006.

Section s0002 (d02-p007 to d02-p010, 194 words) has no checkpoint. It is not a mere bridge: d02-p008 and d02-p009 explain how the clockwork weight turns the lens, why a stopped light is dangerous, and that the weight must be rewound every four hours. The instructions give every body section a checkpoint unless it only bridges two others, is mostly non-prose, or has nothing worth recalling. Suggested fix: Add a checkpoint with one prompt on s0002, for example on what turns the lens and why it has to be rewound through the night, supported by d02-p008 and d02-p009.

Section s0003 (d03-p001 to d03-p007, 311 words) has no checkpoint although it carries several ideas worth recalling in prose: why fog makes the light almost useless (d03-p002, d03-p003), how the fog signal works and when it is started (d03-p004), and why the horn is not sounded all the time (d03-p007). The table d03-p005 is only one block, so the section is not mostly non-prose. Suggested fix: Add a checkpoint with one or two prompts on s0003, for example on why keepers relied on sound in fog and why the horn could not be sounded continuously, supported by d03-p002 to d03-p004 and d03-p007.

Section s0005 (d04-p001 to d04-p008, 321 words) is a whole chapter with no checkpoint. Its prose states recallable ideas: what the count of fog hours showed and why it had gone unnoticed (d04-p005), what Ione did when the clockwork stopped (d04-p006), and what the lighthouse board agreed to (d04-p007). The code block d04-p004 is a single block whose result is restated in prose. Suggested fix: Add a checkpoint with one or two prompts on s0005, for example on what the log count revealed about the fog signal and what came of it, supported by d04-p005 and d04-p007.
